title: system
summary: Execute an operating-system command and return status and output text.

gpu_support.notes: Host-only process operation. Commands must be host character vectors or strings; resident numeric inputs are rejected without provider access.

description: `status = system(command)` runs a host operating-system command. `[status, output] = system(command)` also returns the command's combined standard output and standard error text.
behaviors: Executes commands through cmd /C on Windows and sh -c on Unix-like hosts.
The command must be a character vector or string scalar. Numeric and GPU-resident values are rejected before any process is started.
Pass `'-echo'` as the optional second argument to write command output to the RunMat console while still returning the requested outputs.
Returns status by default; with two requested outputs returns status and combined stdout/stderr text.
When called with zero requested outputs, command output is written to the RunMat console stream.
In WebAssembly builds, returns a nonzero status and an explanatory message because process execution is unavailable.
